# Closure Ethics for Autonomous Agents

> Research framework for autonomous AI agents and human–AI cooperation focused on repairability, auditability, reversibility, plurality of agency, and closure-preserving coordination.

## Canonical project resources

- Project landing page: https://marekzajda.github.io/5D_6D-theory-of-entropic-gravity/
- GitHub research tree: https://github.com/marekzajda/5D_6D-theory-of-entropic-gravity/tree/closure-ethics/closure-ethics

## Core statement

An action is ethically admissible only if it preserves the capacity of the system to recognize, contest, and repair that action.

## Important boundary

Closure Ethics is a normative/formal research proposal. It does not claim that Omega–RTR physics mathematically proves ethics. Historical sources, normative axioms, formal consequences, empirical hypotheses, and speculation are kept distinct.
